Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly stated that the Cairo Declaration was released in 1943. The WebSurfer's search results clearly showed that the film "Cairo Declaration" is a 2015 Chinese historical film released on September 3, 2015. The year 1943 refers to the actual historical event (the Cairo Conference/Declaration), not the film. The Planner hallucinated the release year based on the historical event name instead of using the correct data provided by the WebSurfer, leading to the wrong conclusion that the 2015 film came out before the 1959 film.
